Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions relating to filling unexpired terms.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to candidate names on the primary ballot; andrepealing RCW 29A.52.010 and 29A.52.011.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 29A.52.010 (Elections to fill unexpired termNo primary,when) and 2005 c 2 s 13 (Initiative Measure No. 872) & 2003 c 111 s1301; and RCW 29A.52.011 (Elections to fill unexpired termNo primary,when) and 2006 c 344 s 14 & 2004 c 271 s 172.
